# Kenney audio fixtures

These four Ogg files are the approved, byte-pinned subset used by audio import,
playback, stress, and manual listening tests. They are copied from Kenney's CC0
1.0 Music Jingles and Interface Sounds packs. `fixtures.json` records the source
pages and checksums; the two `*-LICENSE.txt` files are preserved from the archives.

Run `Tools/Audio/AcquireAudioFixtures.ps1 -VerifyCommitted` to verify without
changing the working tree. A maintainer may use `-Refresh` after explicit review.
